Our office lease ends in December. Has the owner sent the renewal terms? Yes. The rent will increase, but parking will be included. That may still be reasonable. Let us compare it with two nearby offices before deciding. I will arrange visits next week.

Two tickets for the special exhibition, please. The next entry time is one thirty. Is that all right? Yes. Can we visit the permanent collection while we wait? Certainly. It is included in your ticket. The entrance is upstairs.

The invoice lists fifteen chairs, but we only received twelve. Three were damaged in transit. We can replace them next Tuesday. Our event is on Monday, so please refund those three instead. I will send a corrected invoice this afternoon.

We would like to have the trees outside our office trimmed. I can send someone to inspect them on Wednesday. Could the work be done over the weekend? The parking area is busy during the week. That should be possible. We will provide a quotation after the inspection.

Attention shoppers. Our store will close at six today for our annual inventory count. The customer service desk will stop accepting returns at five thirty. Online orders can still be placed throughout the evening. We will reopen at our usual time tomorrow. Thank you for your understanding.

Passengers traveling to Lakeside, please note that the ten fifteen service will depart from platform four instead of platform two. The departure time has not changed. Passengers with large luggage should use the elevator at the end of the hall. Staff are available near the ticket counter to assist you.

Hello, this is Maria from the dental clinic. I am calling about your appointment on Thursday afternoon. The dentist needs to attend a professional seminar, so we need to reschedule. We have openings on Friday morning or Monday afternoon. Please call us before five today to let us know which you prefer.

Before entering the production area, please put on the safety glasses provided in the blue cabinet. Photography is not permitted inside the factory. The tour will last forty minutes, and you must remain with your guide at all times. Afterward, refreshments will be served in the visitor center.

Looking for a quiet place to work? River Workspace offers desks and private offices just five minutes from the central station. All memberships include high-speed internet and free coffee. Join before the end of this month and receive your first week at no charge. Visit our website to book a free tour.

Welcome to our annual volunteer dinner. This year, more than two hundred volunteers helped deliver meals to older residents. Before dinner, our coordinator will share a short video of their work. After the meal, we will present certificates to those who have volunteered for five years or more. Thank you for making this program possible.

Good morning. Heavy rain is expected across the region this afternoon, and some local roads may flood. Drivers should allow extra travel time and avoid the riverside route. The rain should stop overnight, with clear skies returning tomorrow morning. The weekend outdoor market is still scheduled to go ahead.

The library will introduce a new reservation system next Monday. Members will be able to reserve study rooms up to two weeks in advance through our website. Each booking may last no more than three hours. If you need help using the system, staff will offer demonstrations at the information desk every morning next week.

Thank you for attending this year’s design conference. Recordings of all presentations will be available to registered participants next week. Please complete the online feedback form before Friday; your suggestions will help us plan next year’s event. Shuttle buses to the train station will leave from the south entrance every fifteen minutes until six.

Starting next month, employees may work from home up to two days per week with their supervisor’s approval. Wednesday will remain an office day so that all teams can meet in person. The technology department will provide instructions for secure remote access this Friday. Please submit your preferred schedule by next Tuesday.

The community center is offering a beginner photography course on Saturday mornings. The course runs for four weeks, and participants should bring a camera or a smartphone. The first class will take place indoors, while the remaining sessions will include walks around the neighborhood. Registration closes on Wednesday.

This is a message for the manager of Green Market. Your refrigerated display unit is ready for delivery. Because the unit is large, please make sure the loading entrance is clear. Our driver can arrive between nine and eleven on Friday. Please call to confirm that a member of staff will be available to sign for it.

You are now standing in the oldest part of the building. Originally a railway waiting room, this hall became a museum in the nineteen eighties. The clock above the door is the only original fitting that remains. The photographs on your left show the station before it closed. Please continue through the double doors to see the transport exhibition.
